label: LLM call
description: One chat-model call: renders the prompt from state and writes the answer text to a channel.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Jinja template; use {{ state.<channel> }} to insert state values.

label: Agent
description: A tool-using agent (LangChain create_agent). Reads and writes the `messages` channel.

inputs.name: middleware
inputs.description: Middleware, applied in order (guardrails, limits, retries…)

approve_tools.title: Tools that need approval
approve_tools.description: Pause for a human before these tools run (approve / edit / reject).

response_format.title: Structured output (JSON Schema)
response_format.description: When set, the agent's final answer is validated against this schema and written to the `structured_response` channel.

label: Deep Agent
description: A planning agent with a virtual filesystem, subagents and long-term memory (create_deep_agent). Reads and writes `messages`.

inputs.name: backend
inputs.description: Default: state files. Long-term folders are mounted at their path.

approve_tools.title: Tools that need approval
approve_tools.description: Pause before these tools run; built-ins such as write_file or task are allowed.

response_format.title: Structured output (JSON Schema)
response_format.description: When set, the agent's final answer is validated against this schema and written to the `structured_response` channel.

label: Subagent
description: A specialist a Deep Agent can delegate to with its `task` tool. The resource name is the subagent name.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Optional: defaults to the Deep Agent's model

description.title: When to use it
description.description: Shown to the main agent to decide when to delegate.

approve_tools.title: Tools that need approval
approve_tools.description: Pause for a human before these tools run (approve / edit / reject).

label: Python script
description: Runs a function from the Workspace: `def run(state) -> dict` (sync or async).

label: Set values
description: Writes templated values into channels, e.g. summary = "Ticket: {{ state.ticket }}".

label: Approval
description: Pauses for a human to approve or reject (optionally editing the shown value).

label: Human input
description: Pauses and asks a person for input (a form when a response schema is set); the answer is written to a channel.

prompt.title: Question
prompt.description: Jinja template, e.g. Which plan should we use for {{ state.customer }}?

response_schema.title: Answer form (JSON Schema)
response_schema.description: Optional; the answer is validated against it and the question is asked again if invalid.

label: Join (wait for all)
description: Waits until every incoming branch has finished, then continues.

label: Map (for each)
description: Runs the step wired to `each` once per list item, in parallel (Send). Results must go to an `append` channel.

outputs.name: each
outputs.description: Worker step, run once per item

outputs.name: empty
outputs.description: Taken when the list is empty (default: END)

item.title: Each item goes to
item.description: The worker sees the current item in this channel

label: Router
description: Chooses the next step: the first case whose CEL condition is true wins, otherwise `default`.

label: Long-term files
description: Mounts a folder backed by the long-term store (StoreBackend), shared across threads for a user, the workflow or one thread.

mount.title: Folder
mount.description: Paths under this folder are stored long-term, e.g. /memories/

scope.title: Shared per
scope.description: user = the run's authenticated user (needs a context field with source 'user')

label: State files
description: Agent files live in the thread's state (StateBackend): they are checkpointed with the thread and vanish with it.

label: Model call limit
description: Stops the agent after N model calls per run or thread (ModelCallLimitMiddleware).

label: Model fallback
description: Tries the wired models in order when the agent's model fails (ModelFallbackMiddleware).

label: Model retry
description: Retries failed model calls with exponential backoff (ModelRetryMiddleware).

on_failure.title: When retries are exhausted
on_failure.description: continue = return an error message to the model; error = raise

label: PII guard
description: Detects PII in messages and blocks, redacts, masks or hashes it (PIIMiddleware).

detector.title: Custom detector (regex)
detector.description: Optional regular expression that replaces the built-in detector.

label: Planning (to-dos)
description: Gives the agent a write_todos tool to plan multi-step work (TodoListMiddleware).

label: Summarization
description: Summarizes old messages when the conversation grows too long (SummarizationMiddleware).

label: Tool call limit
description: Limits tool calls per run or thread, for all tools or one tool (ToolCallLimitMiddleware).

label: Tool retry
description: Retries failed tool calls with exponential backoff (ToolRetryMiddleware).

on_failure.title: When retries are exhausted
on_failure.description: continue = return an error message to the model; error = raise

label: Tool selector
description: Lets a (cheaper) model pick the relevant tools before each call (LLMToolSelectorMiddleware).

label: Chat model
description: A chat model created with init_chat_model("provider:model").

label: HTTP request tool
description: Calls an HTTP API. The resource name is the tool name; the URL is a template over the tool's arguments, e.g. https://api.example.com/orders/{{ args.order_id }}.

description.title: What it does (shown to the model)

args_schema.title: Arguments (JSON Schema)
args_schema.description: What the model must provide; used in the URL as {{ args.<name> }}

send_args.title: Send arguments as
send_args.description: auto = none for GET/DELETE, JSON body otherwise

allowed_domains.title: Allowed domains
allowed_domains.description: Requests to any other host are refused (subdomains are allowed)

label: MCP server
description: All tools of a Model Context Protocol server (langchain.mcp). Use Browse tools to pick tools and see which are destructive.

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: stdio starts a local process: local edition + admin setting only (E042)

tool_filter.title: Only these tools
tool_filter.description: Empty = every tool the server offers

discovered.title: Discovered tools
discovered.description: Filled by Browse tools; used to check approvals (W002, E033)

label: Python tool
description: A LangChain @tool function from the Workspace.
